Contact Wren & Oak Coffee Roasters

Get in touch with the roastery directly at hello@wrenandoak.example or call (503) 555-0142 during business hours. Our roastery is located in Portland, Oregon and is open Tuesday through Saturday, from eight in the morning until four in the afternoon.

If you would like to visit in person, we run a short cupping session every Saturday morning where you can taste the week's roasts before they ship. Contact us ahead of time if you would like to reserve a seat, since space is limited.
